title: River Kwai Bridge
scope: Kanchanaburi railway bridge with open black curved trusses, two angular replacement spans, flared concrete piers, a single meter-gauge track, narrow walking plates and pier refuge bays.
heightPolicy: The model uses a 29 m datum. Track support grades follow the retained Terrarium approaches from about 39.73 m on the southwest side to 34.25 m on the northeast side.
limitations: The track and map outline determine the frame. Pier stations, curved bay spacing, and member sizes are visual approximations based on ordinary photos.
The asymmetric grade adapts standard Terrarium terrain. The deck depicts the current rail crossing and fixed walkways.
